title: crash-ews-preonset: replication materials for "How Much of Crash Early Warning Is Early? Separating Pre-Onset Warning from In-Progress Detection"
description: Analysis notebooks, frozen model files, specification files, stored result tables and a SHA-256 manifest for the article. The repository holds no index levels; the only exchange prices are event closes, a cache fingerprint and one Binance–Coinbase spread file. All rights reserved; values derived from Binance Vision datasets are under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
